claim_boundary: ST-RT and STR-RT are in-domain action-decoder adaptations; neither row is ours and neither open-loop metric is a closed-loop SR/RSR claim.

subtask_rt_dataset.label_source: robot-state/action weak temporal proxies with explicit fallback audit; evaluation uses different source-backed simulator predicates

temporal_video_adjudication.policy: only episodes rejected by the frozen state/action proxy; three staggered contact-sheet samples must reach confidence and boundary-spread consensus

recovery_rt_dataset.source: successful independent PI0.5 oracle behavior after the locked failure becomes active
recovery_rt_dataset.split_derivation: sort SHA-256(hrvla-recovery-data-v1|<scenario>|<trial>) then allocate 14 train, 3 validation, 3 heldout

initialization: seed-matched common HumanoidArena checkpoint selected globally on validation

training.dataloader_worker_rationale: match the common-adaptation memory-safe profile; the 28-worker infrastructure probe exhausted 31 GiB host RAM before optimizer step 1

selection.criterion: one global optimizer step per method with lowest mean of three seed-level macro-per-task action MSE values
